subject: Incubator microgrant top-up reconciliation and invoicing
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma@leaflabs.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@leaflabs.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:22:18 -0800
Subject: Request: incubator microgrant top-up and reconciliation

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick note from the LeafLabs side: our cohort ran hotter than expected in month two and we’ve spent through most of the initial microgrant. The incubator program manager asked whether Redwood can provide a small top-up (one-time) to help finish a demo sprint — ideally as credits we can apply to our account rather than an additional invoice.

We attached a short summary (scoped_topup_request.pdf) describing the incremental usage and proposed milestone: up to $5k in credits, to be consumed within 60 days and reconciled against outcome metrics in the incubator report.

Questions from procurement:
- Is a top-up possible as credits versus a prepaid invoice?
- If it must be invoiced, can you provide a proforma and clarify tax treatment?
- Any precedent for milestone-based release?

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Emma Torres
Head of Operations, LeafLabs
emma@leaflabs.ai
LeafLabs, Inc.

Attachment: scoped_topup_request.pdf (1 page, PDF)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@leaflabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: incubator microgrant top-up and reconciliation

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. We can support both approaches but need internal sign-off for a credits-based top-up (it affects accounting and conversion to committed packages). Looping in Ben (sales) and Lauren (finance) for options. Priyom from Operations to confirm that usage windows and expiry rules can be enforced on the account.

Proposed quick options:
1) One-time credits (non-invoice): up to $5,000 in platform credits, expire in 60 days, issued as account credits against usage. Requires sales + finance approval and an internal memo for accounting (credits burn = promotional revenue recognition).
2) Prepaid invoice: LeafLabs pays an invoice for $5,000 and we issue consumption credits; standard invoicing and tax treatment apply.
3) Milestone release: split the top-up into two $2.5k tranches, release on brief milestone confirmation from the incubator.

Ben/Priyom/Lauren — can each of you weigh in on preferred route and any blockers? Emma — if you have a preference from procurement on credits vs invoice, share that and we’ll move fast.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Startup Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@leaflabs.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:40:29 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: incubator microgrant top-up and reconciliation

Thanks Hannah — quick commercial take from Sales: we can approve a credits-based top-up as a one-time promotional concession for LeafLabs in this program, but recommend setting a clear expiration (60 days OK) and a small eligibility clause (milestone check) so there’s accountability. I’d propose:
- $5,000 platform credits, expiring 60 days after issuance
- If they hit the demo milestone (short checklist in the scoped_topup_request), we mark it as "success" in the cohort ledger for reporting and PR follow-ups
- No conversion to committed discount automatically — if they want a discounted Dedicated conversion later, that’s a separate discussion

Also recommend including a small credit cap per API route to prevent an unusual burst (we can configure via route limits).

If Finance is comfortable with promotional revenue recognition for these credits, Sales will send a short exception memo and a HubSpot note (see link below) to keep the deal record clean.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2026-0923

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@leaflabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: incubator microgrant top-up and reconciliation

Hi all — finance view: credits-as-promotion is acceptable for an incubator concession, but we need the following before issuance:
1) Internal exception memo (sales) documenting business rationale and expected benefit — Ben, please add a one-paragraph note to the HubSpot deal record and attach it to our internal:promo-exceptions folder.
2) Billing contact for LeafLabs and billing address for tax purposes (procurement@leaflabs.ai may have included this).
3) If Emma prefers invoiced prepaid instead, we can send a proforma invoice. Attached a proforma_invoice_stub.pdf to show the fields we require (line item, tax, remit info).

Accounting notes: we will recognize promotional credits as a contra-revenue (marketing/promotions) on issuance; if we do milestone release, please specify the trigger (simple checklist OK) and who at LeafLabs confirms. For US customers, tax is usually not applicable on credits; if LeafLabs is EU/foreign or requests an invoice with VAT, include full billing details.

Attachment: proforma_invoice_stub.pdf (1 page, PDF)

Once we have the memo and billing info, Finance will sign off and Ops (Priyom) can push the credits.

—Lauren Bishop
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@leaflabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:30:44 -0800
Subject: Final: approved $5k credit top-up + next steps

Emma — good news: we approved a one-time $5,000 platform credit top-up for LeafLabs under the incubator program. Details below and attached: redwood-credit-schedule.csv and the proforma invoice stub for your records.

What we’re issuing:
- 1 x $5,000 platform credit balance, appearing on the LeafLabs account within 24 hours of confirmation
- Expiry: 60 days from issuance
- Release: full amount issued up-front (Sales/Finance approved as promotion)
- Milestone & reporting: per your scoped_topup_request, please upload the short incubator demo confirmation to this thread when complete; we will mark success in our cohort ledger for program reporting

Billing & tax: as credits (promotion), no charge will be invoiced. We included a proforma for your procurement team to show value and internal reconciliation. If procurement requires a formal invoice, we can convert to a prepaid invoice — let us know.

Action items:
- Emma: confirm billing contact and whether procurement needs a formal invoice (reply to this thread)
- Priyom: please schedule the credit push (24h SLA) and apply route caps (# suggested: 200k tokens per minute equivalent)
- Ben: paste the short exception memo to the HubSpot deal and mark the promotional tag
- Lauren: save proforma in promo-exceptions and flag for the quarter report

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.com/leaflabs-topup-signature

Thanks everyone — happy to jump on a 15-min sync if needed.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Startup Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-credit-schedule.csv (CSV), proforma_invoice_stub.pdf (PDF)
